components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The default action for opening, choosing, setting up, or requesting access.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 16px; background: #1E3A52; color: #FAFAFA; font: 500 14px/1.25 Gotham, 'Helvetica Neue', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .02em; transition: background 140ms cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1), transform 140ms cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #142838; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #B8483E; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Accent Button

components.css: .ds-tool-card { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 48px minmax(0,1fr) auto; gap: 16px; align-items: start; border: 1px solid #E0E0E0; border-radius: 6px; padding: 32px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #161616; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(22,21,20,.04), 0 1px 1px rgba(22,21,20,.03); font-family: 'Didact Gothic', Gotham, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-tool-card h3 { margin: 0; color: #161616; font: 700 20px/1.25 Gotham, 'Helvetica Neue', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-tool-card p { margin: 8px 0 0; max-width: 38rem; color: #707070; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.65; } .ds-tool-card button { min-height: 44px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 16px; background: #B8483E; color: #fff; font: 500 14px Gotham, sans-serif; } .ds-tool-card button:hover { background: #8C362D; } .ds-tool-card button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #B8483E; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-tool-icon { width: 48px; height: 48px; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 6px; background: #1E3A52; color: #FAFAFA; } .ds-tool-card footer { grid-column: 1 / -1; display: flex; gap: 16px; border-top: 1px solid #E0E0E0; padding-top: 16px; color: #707070; font-size: 14px; } .ds-tool-card footer strong { color: #161616; font-family: Gotham, sans-serif; }

components.css: .ds-opportunity { border: 1px solid #1E3A52; border-radius: 6px; padding: 24px; background: #1E3A52; color: #FAFAFA; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(22,21,20,.04), 0 1px 1px rgba(22,21,20,.03); font-family: 'Didact Gothic', Gotham, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-opportunity > span { color: #DCE3EA; font-size: 14px; } .ds-opportunity h3 { margin: 8px 0; font: 700 20px/1.25 Gotham, sans-serif; } .ds-opportunity p { margin: 0 0 24px; color: #DCE3EA; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; } .ds-opportunity strong { display: block; border-top: 1px solid #2A4A63; padding-top: 16px; font: 500 14px Gotham, sans-serif; } .ds-opportunity button { min-height: 44px; margin-top: 24px; border: 1px solid #FAFAFA; border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 16px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #1E3A52; font: 500 14px Gotham, sans-serif; } .ds-opportunity button:hover { background: #F1F4F7; } .ds-opportunity button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #B8483E; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; color: #161616; font: 500 14px Gotham, 'Helvetica Neue', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { min-height: 44px; border: 1px solid #E0E0E0; border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 12px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #161616; font: 400 16px/1.5 'Didact Gothic', Gotham, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 140ms cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1), box-shadow 140ms cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1); } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: #707070; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { border-color: #B8483E; outline: 2px solid #B8483E; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-nav-item { min-height: 40px; display: flex; align-items: center; border-left: 3px solid transparent; border-radius: 0 6px 6px 0; padding: 8px 12px; background: #1E3A52; color: #DCE3EA; text-decoration: none; font: 500 14px/1.25 Gotham, 'Helvetica Neue', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .02em; transition: background 140ms cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1), color 140ms cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1); } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: #2A4A63; color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-nav-item-active { border-left-color: #B8483E; background: #2A4A63; color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #B8483E; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: PSG Hub is a premium-editorial operational workspace: calm enough for routine use, authoritative enough to establish trust, and explicit enough to guide a busy collision repair owner to the next useful action. Midnight structure, Paper surfaces, precise hairlines, and rare Ember signals create hierarchy without turning the product into a marketing site.
keyCharacteristics: Persistent Midnight navigation with a light Paper workspace
One featured next action and one distinct growth opportunity
Precise 6px geometry and subtle tonal depth
Premium editorial typography with operational density

rules.name: The Rare Signal Rule
rules.body: Ember communicates priority, state, or focus and should occupy less than roughly 10% of a screen.

rules.name: The One Editorial Voice Rule
rules.body: Gotham creates hierarchy and action; Didact Gothic explains. Gotham Rounded stays out of the Hub.

rules.name: The Tonal-First Rule
rules.body: Use color fields and borders before adding shadow.

dos: Make the first useful action dominant while keeping every customer tool reachable.
Explain plan, setup, data, role, and location availability in plain language.
Use official PSG SVG assets with correct lockup, minimum size, and clear space.
Maintain WCAG 2.2 AA contrast, keyboard access, visible focus, and textual status.
donts: Do not build a generic grid of equal SaaS cards.
Do not present decorative metrics or unavailable features as live.
Do not scatter Ember across decorative elements.
Do not show internal Agents or staff workflows to customer users.
Do not redraw, distort, recolor, crop, or append HUB to the PSG logo.
